summary: A client-message selector fold pass now folds at least one row before its 10 ms budget can stop it, so a loaded host whose own reads outlast the budget still finishes the fold instead of saving the same place every loan; the marks lifecycle test drains the fold on both twins before comparing them

replay.detail: No claim or projection replay; the fold resumes from its saved FOLD_MARKER work as before.

schema.detail: No table or schema change. Test-support builds read one optional meta key that pins a store's fold budget; release builds never read or write it.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: Mixed-version fleets are unaffected: the change is local to how much of the local selector fold one pass does; no wire, client or replicated-state change.
